meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Egypt (Unitary National Jurisdiction, no separate sub-state company registry)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (mixed with limited Islamic Sharia principles in commercial morality and personal status matters)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Egypt-United Kingdom Bilateral Investment Treaty and Double Taxation Agreement
Egypt-France Bilateral Investment Treaty (1974, as amended)
Egypt-United States Trade and Investment Framework Agreement (TIFA)
Egypt-Saudi Arabia and Egypt-UAE Bilateral Investment Treaties and Double Taxation Agreements

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law No. 80 of 2002 on Anti-Money Laundering and Combating the Financing of Terrorism, as amended by Law No. 8 of 2015 and Law No. 36 of 2020; Executive Regulations of the AML Law (Prime Ministerial Decree No. 877 of 2003, as amended by Decrees No. 1693 of 2017 and No. 1227 of 2021); Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 (as amended by Law No. 90 of 2018 mandating UBO identification); GAFI Executive Regulations Decree No. 3060 of 2017; Egyptian Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Combating Unit (EMLCU) circulars; FATF Recommendations as implemented for the MENAFATF region.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing of the foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent companies registry of the shareholder's home jurisdiction (e.g., Companies House, UK; Secretary of State, USA)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille by the home jurisdiction's designated competent authority (Egypt is a contracting party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention, effective 2022)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney (Wakala) to the Egyptian incorporation agent / retained law firm
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public of the grantor's jurisdiction, countersigned by the competent apostille authority
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (for states party to the 1961 Convention); otherwise Egyptian consular legalization at the Egyptian Embassy or Consulate abroad

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution of the foreign corporate shareholder authorizing the Egyptian LLC incorporation and initial UBO appointments
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate secretary of the foreign shareholder, with notarization and apostille
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille via the home jurisdiction's competent authority, accepted by GAFI

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified passport copies and economic residency proof of each natural-person UBO, manager, and authorized signatory
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public at home jurisdiction or Egyptian consulate for overseas individuals
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Egyptian consular legalization, followed by Arabic language certified translation in Egypt

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and prior two-year audited financial statements of the non-Egyptian corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing bank and licensed external auditor of the foreign shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Certified true copies legalized by apostille or consular authentication where raised abroad

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based screening of all shareholders, UBOs, directors, managers, and authorized signatories against the EMLCU consolidated domestic terrorist list, the UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List, the OFAC SDN and Non-SDN Sector Sanctions lists, UK/EU consolidated sanctions and terrorist identification lists, and Interpol notices, performed pre-incorporation and refreshed on a rolling annual basis; enhanced due diligence for politically exposed persons (PEPs) as defined by FATF and EMLCU guidance, with source-of-funds and source-of-wealth verification, and mandatory suspicious transaction reporting to EMLCU under Article 8 of Law No. 80 of 2002.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) One-Stop Shop electronic investment services platform (www.gafi.gov.eg), with name pre-clearance coordinated against the Commercial Registry database of the Internal Trade Development Authority (ITDA)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The legal company name must be registered in the Arabic script under the principle of Arabic primacy for all Egyptian corporate and commercial documents; a phonetic English transliteration may be recorded as a supplementary trade name only if it is a direct translation and does not materially conflict with the Arabic short-name string. The name must end with the legal form 'LLC' (Limited Liability Company) in Arabic or English and must satisfy the content requirements of Article 27 of Law No. 159 of 1981 and Law No. 34 of 1976 on Commercial Registry.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Bank / بنك and related financial services terms (requires prior Central Bank of Egypt licensing)
Insurance / تأمين (requires prior Financial Regulatory Authority approval)
Securities / أوراق مالية (requires prior Financial Regulatory Authority licensing)
State / دولة and Public Authority / هيئة عامة (deemed governmental in tone and prohibited)
Egypt / مصر and Cairo / القاهرة as leading tokens (requires prior GAFI subcommittee approval)
Islamic / إسلامي and religious-identifying tokens (requires Al-Azhar competent council endorsement)
International / دولي and Global / عالمي (requires verifiable cross-border business volume evidence)
Arab / عربي as a leading token (subject to Ministry of Foreign Affairs authorization policy)
Tokens suggesting government sponsorship, public utilities, security agencies, or diplomatic missions
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A formal Arabic-language administrative grievance must be lodged at the GAFI Investment Complaints Office within 15 calendar days of the rejection notification, itemizing the legal grounds and a substitute name alternative. The grievance shall be reviewed by the GAFI internal committee, which must issue a decision within 30 days. If the internal objection is dismissed or no decision is released within the 30-day window, the applicant may file an annulment suit before the Council of State (Administrative Court) under Article 93 of Investment Law No. 72 of 2017; meanwhile, the applicant is advised to re-file the name clearance under a modified Arabic short-string to avoid commercial delay.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office acceptance is only partial. GAFI and the Commercial Registry require a physical Egyptian domicile for service of process and statutory record keeping under Articles 235-237 of Law No. 159 of 1981. For a parcel consolidation hub, a serviced executive suite may be accepted for the registered office, but only if a separate operational sorting and linehaul facility exists in Egypt evidenced by a registered leasehold; a pure virtual or online-only address without an operational hub is rejected for ISIC 5229 logistics activity.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High, approximately 68-75% probability within the first operating year. GAFI, the Commercial Registry Office, and the Customs Authority under Law No. 207 of 2020 conduct unannounced on-site inspections of e-commerce logistics and consolidation premises; parcel hubs handling international shipments are periodically audited for customs-bonded inventory practices and commercial record keeping without prior notice.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory range prescribed by GAFI fee regulation for LLC registration (sliding scale by nominal share capital)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Official Gazette publication of the certificate of incorporation (Al-Waqi Al-Masriyya)
Tax registration (commercial tax card and income tax certification for the LLC charter)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Social insurance registration intimation for the initial statutory officers
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Compulsory post-incorporation registration, no filing fee at formation stage

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Stamp duty and legalization of the registered office lease contract (executive suite required for domicile)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Egyptian Notary / Land Registry and Ministry of Finance Stamp Office

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Egyptian Companies Law No. 159 of 1981, as amended by Law No. 148 of 2019 (Limited Liability Company provisions and Executive Regulations No. 96 of 1982); Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 (GAFI incorporation paths), Arts. 27-29
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) - Companies Incorporation Department integrated with the Egyptian Commercial Registry under the Ministry of Trade and Industry
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association (Essentiales) filed through the GAFI One-Stop Shop, leading to issuance of the Certificate of Incorporation (Shehadat Ta'sis)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: The Companies Law imposes no statutory minimum paid-up capital for an Egyptian LLC; the founders freely determine the capital in the Articles of Association. The entire subscribed capital must be deposited into a blocked escrow account maintained in the name of the future LLC at a licensed Egyptian bank and must remain blocked until registration; the deposit certificate is a mandatory attachment to the GAFI filing, and the block is released on issuance of the Certificate of Incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: BY UNANIMOUS WRITTEN RESOLUTION OF THE FOUNDERS: RESOLVED, that the Memorandum and Articles of Association are adopted and the founders subscribe in full to the share capital set out therein; RESOLVED, that the registered office is fixed at the parcel consolidation hub, Egypt; RESOLVED, that the capital escrow account opened at an Egyptian licensed bank is approved and funds remain blocked until the Certificate of Incorporation is issued; RESOLVED, that the Managers and authorized signatories are appointed; RESOLVED, that GAFI incorporation, Commercial Registry entry, tax registration, banking mandates, common seal, and e-signatures are authorized; and RESOLVED, that all actions taken in furtherance of this resolution are ratified and binding upon the LLC with immediate effect.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI Online One-Stop Shop - Name Reservation Module (gafi.gov.eg)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit three proposed Arabic/Latin company names through the GAFI electronic portal. The system screens for identity collision with existing registered entities and programmed restrictions on misleading, religious, or geographic terms. The chosen name must include the 'LLC' suffix. The reservation certificate is issued digitally and is valid for 60 days, during which the formation file must be completed.
required_dossiers: Name reservation application form (Form CN-1)
Founders' passport copies (all nationalities)
Notarized power of attorney if represented by a registered legal agent
Statement of the proposed business purpose in Arabic
Contact details and email of the designated founder
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for similarity or prohibited terms, refile with a distinct distinctive element within 15 days. An appeal may be submitted in writing to the GAFI Grievance Committee under Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 Art. 64, with a statutory decision deadline of 30 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Notarization of the Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Egyptian Notary Public (Notary Office, Ministry of Justice) with corporate counsel registered before GAFI
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Arabic Articles of Association with a bilingual English schedule, clearly stating capital, share allocation, management structure, registered office, and the parcel consolidation business purpose. Signatures of all founders or their attorney-in-fact under a notarized power of attorney must be personally acknowledged before the notary. The notary authenticates the signatures, applies the national revenue stamp duty, enters the contract into the notarial archive, and returns certified copies to the founders.
required_dossiers: Draft Articles of Association in Arabic (five originals on revenue-stamped paper)
Certified Arabic translations of foreign founders' passport copies
National ID copies of Egyptian founders or certified copies of commercial registration for foreign corporate founders
Tax Identification Number of any Egyptian resident founder
Original notarized power of attorney if signing by representation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where the notary queries identity documents or translations, provide apostilled or certified supplementary evidence. If the capital allocation clause is ambiguous, execute a rectification deed before the same notary and attach the notarial transcript to the GAFI filing pending review.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening the Blocked Capital Escrow Account
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Egyptian commercial bank Corporate Banking Desk (e.g., National Bank of Egypt or Commercial International Bank)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the notarized Articles of Association, the GAFI name reservation certificate, and founder identity documents to the bank's corporate desk. Deposit the full subscribed share capital in EGP or an accepted foreign currency. The bank issues a Blocked Account Certificate (Shahadat Tawseej) declaring the amount held and the prohibition on release until GAFI confirmation of incorporation, thereby satisfying the paid-up capital rule.
required_dossiers: Notarized Articles of Association
GAFI name reservation certificate
Original passports and national IDs of all founders and authorized signatories
AML/KYC questionnaire and source-of-funds declaration under AML Law No. 80 of 2002
Founders' resolution authorizing the escrow account opening
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank applies enhanced due diligence to non-resident founders, submit a beneficial ownership statement and sworn CV to the Compliance Officer. If the bank refuses the account without a legal basis, escalate in writing to the bank's chief compliance officer and, if unresolved, to the Central Bank of Egypt banking complaint unit.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: GAFI Incorporation Filing and Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI One-Stop Shop (OSS) - Cairo headquarters or the official e-establishment portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the complete incorporation folder to the GAFI case officer, including the notarized contract, the escrow certificate, and the lease of the registered office. The reviewer authenticates all documents, confirms compliance of the business purpose with the Investment Law negative list, and collects the state filing fees. Upon approval, GAFI issues the electronic Certificate of Incorporation and the company's GAFI file number and corporate identity code.
required_dossiers: GAFI incorporation application form (Form Ta'sis)
Notarized Articles of Association in Arabic
Blocked account certificate issued by the bank
Lease contract or title deed of the registered office with a valid notarization
Declaration of no prior criminal record and no bankruptcy for each manager, with managers' written consents
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried, the OSS issues a deficiency note identifying the missing documents or legal inconsistencies; correction must be submitted within 30 days. A rejection may be appealed to the GAFI Investment Grievance Committee under Law No. 72 of 2017 Art. 64, which must issue its decision within 30 days of the appeal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial Registry Entry and Corporate Seal Engraving
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial Registry Directorate of the Ministry of Trade and Industry, operating in coordination with the GAFI desk
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Following the GAFI Certificate of Incorporation, the Commercial Registry opens a permanent commercial file for the LLC, issues the Commercial Registry Extract (Mustakhraj Qayd Tijari), and records the authorized signatures and company seal. The seal must be engraved by a licensed engraver strictly according to the registered template, and the signature specimens of managers are logged in the registry file.
required_dossiers: GAFI Certificate of Incorporation
Notarized Articles of Association
Lease contract of the registered office
Manager consent letters with national ID or passport copies
Receipt of commercial registry fee payment
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry issues an observation regarding the lease or managers' eligibility, submit the corrected documentation within the stated cure period. Any disputed refusal may be brought before the Ministry of Trade and Industry Trade Registry Review Commission for an administrative decision within 15 working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration: Tax Card, VAT and E-Invoicing Enrollment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) - integration hub reachable through the GAFI One-Stop Shop and the ETA e-invoicing portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: GAFI transmits the incorporation data electronically to the ETA, after which the LLC collects its Tax Card (Tazkirat Darbi) and VAT registration certificate under the Value Added Tax Law No. 67 of 2016. The company must then complete enrollment in the mandatory e-invoicing and e-receipts system, appoint a tax agent, and obtain the annual withholding tax clearance schedule. Registration is completed via the ETA portal with electronic signature activation.
required_dossiers: GAFI Certificate of Incorporation
Commercial Registry Extract
Managers' IDs or valid passports
Lease deed of the registered office and utility bill
Tax agent mandate and company bank account details
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the ETA issues a Deficiency Note on missing data, the company has 15 days to respond, failing which the file may be suspended under Law No. 158 of 2017. An appeal may be filed with the ETA Internal Recourse Committee within 30 days, and all decisions are reviewable by the Tax Courts on payment of the contested amount as a bond.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Organization for Social Insurance (NOSI) - district office with jurisdiction over the registered office of the hub
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The LLC registers as an employing establishment (Wisha) on the NOSI electronic portal, submits the full list of managers and initial employees, and receives the employer registration number. Monthly contributions for pension and work-injury schemes are calculated on the statutory wage base and are payable by the 15th day of the following month. Registration must be completed within 30 days of the date of first hire.
required_dossiers: Commercial Registry Extract
GAFI Certificate of Incorporation
Notarized Articles of Association
National ID or passport copies of all managers and employees
Initial payroll schedule with declared contribution base
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If NOSI queries payroll under-declaration, the employer must submit a corrected contribution list within 10 days; arrears accrue at 2% per month under Law No. 148 of 2019. Disputes on contribution classification may be escalated to the NOSI Insurance Inspection Committee, with an appeal to the administrative court if the committee decision is unfavorable.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Postal Sector Regulatory Department of the National Telecom Regulatory Authority (NTRA), in coordination with the General Authority for Industrial Development (GAID) for the physical warehouse operating permit
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Courier and Parcel Consolidation Facility Operator License under Postal Law No. 46 of 2018, supplemented by a GAID Industrial/Warehouse Operating Permit (Form W-1) and, for air linehaul direct-injection, Regulated Agent accreditation under the Egyptian Civil Aviation Authority air cargo security program

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Egyptian Environmental Affairs Agency (EEAA), Ministry of Environment - regional branch with jurisdiction over the hub district
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B (Environmental Scoping Study) under the EEAA Screening Lists of Law No. 4 of 1994: a parcel sorting hub under 10,000 square meters with only backup generators, office operations, and a light delivery fleet requires a simplified environmental scoping statement, not a full EIA Report; the classification escalates to Category A (full EIA) if the facility includes a customs-bonded hazardous cargo zone, waste treatment, or thermal processing units.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater: no process discharge; sanitary effluent to public sewer must comply with Law No. 48 of 1982 discharge limits: BOD not exceeding 60 mg/L, TSS not exceeding 60 mg/L, oil and grease not exceeding 15 mg/L. VOCs: degreasers and paints used in parcel repacking must meet a mass emission threshold of no more than 0.25 kg VOC per hour with a validated capture system. Diesel backup generators must comply with Law No. 4 of 1994 Annex A emission limits: particulate matter no more than 50 mg/Nm3, NOx no more than 400 ppm, and CO no more than 100 ppm. Residual parcel sorting waste is non-hazardous and must be transported by a licensed waste carrier under Waste Management Law No. 202 of 2020; leaking or damaged lithium-ion batteries and other hazardous residues must be segregated, manifested, and delivered to a licensed treatment facility under Decree No. 100 of 2020 with a six-year retention of manifests.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: The General Directorate of Civil Defense of the Ministry of Interior must issue a final Fire Safety Certificate after on-site inspection, verifying functional fire alarms, extinguishers, emergency exit signage, evacuation drills, and sprinkler zoning. The district engineering administration must certify structural load capacity for the racking and mezzanine systems, an insurance load inspection certificate included. The Ministry of Manpower Occupational Safety and Health Department must issue a workplace clearance confirming completion of a risk assessment, first-aid stations, PPE audit, and a certified fire safety officer on staff as required for facilities employing more than 20 workers.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) - National portal: https://www.eta.gov.eg; e-invoicing and e-receipt platform: https://einvoicing.eta.gov.eg; integrated customs single window: NAFEZA (CargoX platform).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign investor first registers the Egyptian LLC in the Commercial Register (within 30 days of commencement) and obtains an activity license from the competent governorate. The entity then files unified tax registration with the ETA using Form No. 1 at the tax office having territorial jurisdiction over the registered office, attaching Arabic-translated and notarised constitutional documents, foreign registry extract, board resolution, lease contract, bank account confirmation and financial statements. The ETA verifies the file and issues the unified Tax Card containing the TIN for income tax, payroll withholding, VAT and stamp tax. Foreign companies that only render remote services without a permanent establishment are not eligible for a TIN and settle VAT under the recipient's reverse charge mechanism.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation: A resident Egyptian LLC is taxable on worldwide net profits at the standard corporate income tax rate of 22.5% (Income Tax Law No. 91 of 2005). No pass-through or look-through treatment is available to shareholders; dividends distributed to foreign shareholders are subject to the 10% dividend withholding tax unless reduced by treaty.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box classification or hybrid mismatch election exists in Egypt. Limited elections and rulings available include: (i) treaty permanent establishment attribution for foreign companies operating through an Egyptian branch; (ii) deemed-profit taxation for international transport; (iii) voluntary VAT registration below the compulsory threshold; (iv) advance pricing agreements (APAs) for intra-group transactions; (v) tax rate stabilization commitments included in investment approvals under Investment Law No. 72 of 2017; and (vi) an irrevocable election between an Egyptian subsidiary or branch form at the time of entry.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT - Value Added Tax under Law No. 67 of 2016 (replacing the former General Sales Tax Law)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EGP 500,000 of annual turnover of taxable goods and services; mandatory VAT registration within 30 days of crossing the threshold (VAT Law No. 67 of 2016, Art. 27). Foreign suppliers providing cross-border digital or logistics services are generally taxed under reverse charge unless the services are zero-rated as exports.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory e-invoicing (B2B) and e-receipts (B2C) phased in by ETA decrees from 2021 to 2024 for all VAT-registered taxpayers. Invoices must be transmitted in real time to the ETA e-invoicing platform (einvoicing.eta.gov.eg) via certified M2M API integration (JSON/XML schema) or the ETA web portal. Every accepted invoice receives an ETA-issued UUID, unique invoice code and QR code digital stamp; invoices that fail fiscal clearance are legally treated as not issued for VAT purposes. The e-invoicing system is interoperable with the NAFEZA Customs single window for export declarations.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods are zero-rated when they physically leave Egyptian customs territory and are sold to a non-resident purchaser, supported by a completed customs export declaration and shipping documents. Services are zero-rated when rendered to a non-resident recipient located outside Egypt and used wholly outside Egypt; this expressly covers logistics services connected to exports and transit, including parcel consolidation, sorting, warehousing, handling, packing and direct-injection linehaul for e-commerce parcels. The zero rate is denied if the exporter fails to prove the export within the statutory time limit or if foreign currency proceeds are not repatriated to Egypt. Input VAT recovery on zero-rated export costs is allowed only after the export documentation package is substantiated.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (electronic NAFEZA/CargoX export entry for each consolidated parcel shipment)
Bill of Lading or Master Air Waybill evidencing physical exit of goods from Egypt
Inward Remittance Certificate (bank confirmation evidencing hard-currency repatriation of export proceeds)
Commercial invoice and zero-rated VAT invoice carrying the e-invoice UUID and QR code matching the customs declaration
Packing list, parcel manifests, purchase orders and foreign currency account statements
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The ETA conducts cross-matching audits within the five-year statutory limitation window, reconciling e-invoice zero-rated outputs, VAT returns, Customs export entries in NAFEZA and Central Bank of Egypt banking data. Failure to produce the full documentation bundle, missing FX repatriation evidence, or late receipt of proceeds triggers retrospective reversal of the zero rate and assessment of 14% VAT on the exporting entity with delay fines and interest. Deliberate submission of forged declarations or counterfeit proof of export constitutes tax evasion under VAT Law No. 67 of 2016 and Income Tax Law No. 91 of 2005, exposing the taxpayer to criminal prosecution, imprisonment, monetary fines, immediate refund clawback with accrued penalties, suspension of the Tax Card, removal from the exporter registry and blacklisting from e-invoicing clearance.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Egypt (CBE), governed by Law No. 194 of 2020 (Central Bank and Banking System Law); foreign exchange authorization and licensing of dealing banks are further regulated by CBE Foreign Exchange Circulars and Law No. 636 of 1975, as amended.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The EGP is a managed float with substantive current-account convertibility for trade, services, profit repatriation, and dividend remittances, provided the underlying economic purpose is evidenced to a CBE-licensed authorized dealer bank. The capital account is subject to CBE authorization; equity capital inflows into an Egyptian LLC are freely transferable through licensed banks when accompanied by the share subscription agreement, registration with the General Authority for Investment (GAFI), and the inward transfer certificate. Profit and dividend repatriation by the LLC requires audited financial statements, a dividend distribution resolution of the shareholders, tax clearance certificates confirming CIT and stamp duty settlement, and conversion at the prevailing interbank market rate. Practical hurdle: recurring USD/EGP liquidity tightness may delay hard-currency payouts, and treasury operations must avoid parallel-market channels entirely.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: For cross-border logistics, parcel consolidation, and linehaul services invoiced in foreign currency, export/service proceeds must be repatriated to Egypt through a CBE-licensed bank within 180 days from the date of the final invoice or service completion. The standing baseline under the current flexible exchange-rate regime does not impose a fixed mandatory conversion ratio; proceeds may be retained in a foreign-currency account and converted at market rate when EGP disbursements arise. However, CBE has from time to time issued temporary administrative instructions mandating conversion of a percentage of export proceeds (e.g., 50–100% during balance-of-payments stress), so the treasury function must monitor CBE foreign-exchange circulars on a rolling basis. Non-repatriation within 180 days triggers bank reporting to CBE, cancellation of interbank buying-rate access, and administrative penalties.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account plus Capital Escrow Account, dual-currency USD/EGP
Operational Account plus Trade Finance Sub-limits
Operational Account plus Treasury and FX Hedging Facility

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: QNB Alahly (Qatar National Bank Alahly S.A.E.)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Offshore digital EMIs, including Airwallex, are rated 'Medium' feasibility: they are not CBE-licensed payment institutions in Egypt, and Law No. 194 of 2020 reserves money-transfer and payment services to CBE-licensed entities. They cannot lawfully collect local-card, InstaPay, or Meeza settlements on behalf of the Egyptian LLC without a local sponsor bank. Their legally viable role is confined to outbound vendor disbursements, multi-currency settlement with non-Egyptian counterparties, and netting of freight payments, while all inbound capital, export proceeds, and statutory corporate accounts must reside in an Egyptian licensed bank. The recommended architecture is a sponsor-bank-anchored overlay in which Airwallex functions as a treasury execution layer rather than a regulated local account.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is effectively mandatory for at least one director and all authorized signatories at the initial corporate onboarding session in Egypt; remote video KYC is not broadly accepted for non-resident shareholders. The LLC's corporate resolution, board authorization, and powers of attorney must be notarized and legalized, with apostille certification if the foreign jurisdiction is party to the Hague Apostille Convention. The bank's compliance team will conduct an in-person interview covering UBO verification, source of funds and wealth, projected transaction volumes, and trade-flow documentation. Non-resident directors who cannot travel face a 4- to 8-week onboarding timeline and must execute a power of attorney before the Egyptian consulate or rely on a locally resident authorized manager.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO structure of a non-resident single-member LLC displaying no obvious domestic economic footprint or physical substance in Egypt
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full ownership-chain chart to natural-person shareholders; certificate of incorporation, memorandum, shareholders' register, certified board resolution; audited group financial statements; abstracts from the Commercial Registry; and a signed source-of-funds declaration with proof of address, passport, and residency for each UBO.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border parcel consolidation receiving e-commerce merchant collections that appear as fragmented inbound transfers from many unrelated remitters
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed master service agreements between the Egyptian LLC and each cross-border e-commerce platform or carrier; monthly settlement reports; customs declarations and manifest excerpts for consolidated parcels; invoice-to-shipment linkage tables; and a documented operating cash-flow model demonstrating that fragmentation is inherent to parcel aggregation rather than layering.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High transaction velocity with thousands of small-value wires per month, creating a structuring red flag in transaction monitoring systems
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: ERP and warehouse-log extracts with volumetric throughput metrics; customs-clearing statistics aligned with ISIC 5229; prepaid logistics contracts with fixed unit economics; and an independent auditor's letter certifying transaction-level reconciliation controls and daily settlement procedures.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Payments to or from countries on UN, EU, OFAC, or other sanctions and counter-terrorism watchlists, including transit states in the Mediterranean and MENA e-commerce lanes
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Real-time counterparty screening policy embedded in the company's trade compliance system; documented negative-screening results for each transaction; an origin/destination country matrix; and retention of bills of lading, CMR documents, and airway bills for at least five years to substantiate the physical cargo trail.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant protocol for foreign shareholder equity injection: (i) open a USD-denominated capital sub-account at a Tier-1 Egyptian bank; (ii) execute an inward SWIFT MT103 transfer using purpose code 'Equity Capital Contribution', referencing the signed share subscription agreement, the LLC's Commercial Registry number, and the GAFI registration reference; (iii) instruct the remitting bank to populate the field 72/77T beneficiary information line with the LLC's exact legal name and account number to avoid rejection under Egypt's FX messaging rules; (iv) upon receipt, the Egyptian bank issues an inward transfer certificate and registers the flow with CBE/GAFI as foreign direct investment; (v) the capital may be retained in USD or converted to EGP at the interbank rate; repatriation rights on liquidation, capital reduction, or dividend distribution are preserved only if the inflow was properly registered.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound treasury disbursements for linehaul carriers, customs brokers, fuel, equipment, and international logistics partners should use the following clearing rails: (i) SWIFT MT103 for high-value non-Egyptian supplier payments, with the purchase order number and precise payment narrative embedded; (ii) Commercial Letter of Credit, payable at 30–90 days, issued by a Tier-1 Egyptian bank and advised through the beneficiary's confirming bank for large equipment or contractual commitments; (iii) CBE RTGS and Meeza/InstaPay local clearing for EGP-denominated vendor payments, payroll, and customs duty settlements to minimize friction costs; and (iv) multi-currency settlement wallets at the Egyptian sponsoring bank with daily netting cycles so that inbound e-commerce collections offset outbound freight payables before any residual balance is converted into EGP.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable FX Forward contracts in USD/EGP with tenor up to 180 days, issued by CBE-licensed dealing banks against evidenced underlying trade flows or export invoices
Onshore FX Swap structures, including spot/forward and forward/forward combinations, executed through an authorized dealer to bridge timing gaps between hard-currency receipts and EGP disbursements
Cross-currency swap facilities for capital-account hedging when structuring shareholder loans or external financing for hub CAPEX
Collared FX structures combining purchased options with sold options, available from Tier-1 banks under an approved derivatives addendum for corporates with documented underlying exposure

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Commercial Registry Office, GAFI (General Authority for Investment and Free Zones)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually for the calendar registration year: renewal declaration and payment due during the window from 1 January to 31 March.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal attracts a statutory late fee plus a per-month penalty equal to the registration fee; the register record is classified as inactive after a 30-day grace period, and if delinquency exceeds six months GAFI may administratively strike off the commercial registration entry, suspending the LLC's legal personality.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax (CIT) Return with Audited Financial Statements and Transfer Pricing Form
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA), Income Tax Department, electronic filing portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 30 April following the mandatory 31 December financial year-end; this is the four-month statutory filing window under Egyptian Income Tax Law No. 91 of 2005.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing and payment attract a monthly late-filing penalty of 5% of the tax due (capped at 50%) plus statutory default interest; continued default triggers enforced bank-account attachment and asset seizure by the ETA and, when combined with two consecutive years of non-clearance, exposes the company to GAFI strike-off from the companies registry.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: General Assembly Approval of Annual Financial Statements and Deposit of Approval Resolution with the Companies Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Companies Registry of GAFI (companies compliance filing); resolution retained in the company Minute Book.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Shareholders' meeting must be convened no later than six months after the financial year-end (by 30 June for calendar-year filers); the approved resolution and audited accounts must be deposited with GAFI within 30 days after the meeting.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to hold the statutory meeting or to deposit the approved financial statements triggers monetary penalties under Companies Law No. 194 of 2023; two consecutive missed annual deposits are treated as administrative non-compliance leading to GAFI strike-off of the LLC.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership (UBO) Declaration and Register Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: GAFI Companies Registry and the company's AML compliance officer (internal register file)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 30 June, aligned with the statutory general meeting window; any change arising from quota or beneficial-ownership transfers must be notified to GAFI within 15 calendar days of the transfer.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-filing is an AML regulatory offence under Egypt's Anti-Money Laundering Law No. 80 of 2002; sanctions include a fine up to EGP 500,000, blockage of subsequent share or quota transfer clearances, and suspension of GAFI corporate e-services for the entity.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Audit is mandatory for every Egyptian LLC regardless of turnover under the Companies Law, unless the entity qualifies for the micro-enterprise simplified-accounting regime in the Egyptian MSME Law; the e-commerce parcel-consolidation and cross-border settlement activity of this LLC will exceed the micro-enterprise threshold and therefore requires a full statutory audit by a licensed public accountant each financial year.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Egyptian Accounting Standards (EAS), as issued under Egyptian law and substantially converging with IFRS; EAS is the primary statutory basis for the financial statements, while full IFRS is permitted only as a supplementary consolidation basis for a foreign parent or bank requirement.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The LLC must maintain an on-site Beneficial Ownership Register and file UBO disclosures with GAFI at incorporation and within 15 days of any quota or beneficial-ownership transfer. Annually, the manager must re-certify the UBO register by 30 June, reconcile current member and quota allocations against notarized transfer instruments and capital-change filings, and file a confirmation resolution with GAFI; no quota transfer may be registered unless the UBO declaration is materially consistent with the transfer record.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 1,200 – 3,000 per annum for a physical Cairo registered office plus a licensed corporate agent or legal representative, including mail handling and regulator correspondence.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,500 – 5,000 per annum for a licensed Egyptian audit firm preparing EAS or IFRS-ready audited financial statements and the CIT filing package.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: General regime 22.5%. Licensed free-zone enterprises under Investment Law No. 72/2017 may qualify for corporate income tax exemption on export-oriented operations, subject to a 1%-5% annual license fee; onshore eligible logistics and infrastructure projects may receive a statutory reduction of investment costs from the taxable base (up to 50% as prescribed). No statutory onshore tax holiday is available outside the free-zone system.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form No. 45 (Corporate Income Tax Return) together with the transfer pricing disclosure annex and financial statements; filed through the Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) e-filing portal (e-TAX).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within four months after the close of the fiscal year; for a 31 December year-end the return is due on or before 30 April. Quarterly estimated tax payments are payable on the first month following each quarter.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Company identification: TIN, legal name, entity type, fiscal year-end, Egyptian commercial registration number, and place of effective management.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State clearly that the Egyptian LLC is a tax-resident company; disclose any non-resident directors and identify the ultimate beneficial owner; do not claim exemption merely because shareholders or decision-makers are abroad.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total revenue: gross sales, parcel consolidation fees, handling and line-haul charges, insurance recoveries, and other operating income derived from Egyptian and cross-border e-commerce logistics.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include all income attributable to the Egyptian fixed place of business or Egyptian-scope services; allocate revenue using OECD permanent establishment attribution principles where the LLC acts as a dependent agent or fixed place of business of a foreign group company.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductible expenses: cost of goods and services, third-party sorting and transportation costs, premises rent, salaries, depreciation, interest, and administrative overheads attributable to the Egyptian activity.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Claim only expenses actually borne by the Egyptian entity and supported by valid invoices and contracts; related-party service and interest charges must satisfy the arm's length principle and be covered by contemporaneous transfer pricing documentation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Prior-year tax loss carryforward: amount of remaining losses brought forward from earlier years, limited to five tax years, and set off against current-year taxable profit.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident owner cannot offset foreign-parent losses against Egyptian profits; the Egyptian entity may only use losses recorded in the Egyptian statutory accounts and reported in prior Egyptian tax returns.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax computation: taxable income after deductions, statutory rate, prepayments, estimated tax paid, foreign tax credits or treaty withholding credits, and final tax payable or refund claimed.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply the 22.5% corporate rate; if claiming treaty benefits, attach the treaty residency certificate and reconcile the tax with the withholding tax schedule. Branch remittance exposure must be reflected if the entity is treated as a permanent establishment of a foreign company.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Transfer pricing disclosures: controlled transactions, related-party financing, intangible or royalty payments, management fees, and any arm's length adjustments made during the year.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report all cross-border contracts with the foreign parent, e-commerce marketplace operators, parcel carriers, payment-service platforms, and affiliated logistics providers; state the selected transfer pricing method and attach a comparability study if the documentation threshold is exceeded.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Withholding tax schedule: Egyptian tax withheld on royalties, interest, dividends, and service payments remitted to non-residents.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach evidence of tax withheld on foreign payments, tax residency certificates obtained from foreign recipients, and the DTA articles relied upon; do not apply a reduced withholding rate without ETA-approved administrative evidence.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing is subject to a monthly late-payment surcharge of 2% on the unpaid tax plus administrative fines for non-submission of the annual return; incorrect or false returns attract statutory penalties and, where fraud is established, criminal sanctions. The ETA may also issue an estimated assessment.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% on dividends distributed to non-resident shareholders of an Egyptian LLC; resident corporate shareholders may be exempt under dividend-receipt exemption rules.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke DTA relief, the non-resident shareholder or beneficial owner must secure a Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from the treaty partner's competent authority, submit the original or certified copy and a treaty-benefit claim to the Egyptian payor before payment, and, where required, obtain ETA approval. The payor must maintain the TRC, DTA article analysis, ultimate-beneficial-owner declaration, and withholding computation records; if the reduced rate is not applied at source, the claimant may file a refund application with the ETA within the statutory limitation period.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rates: 20% WHT on royalties and payments for patents, trademarks, know-how, and technical services; 20% WHT on interest paid to non-residents. Treaty rates commonly reduce royalty or interest WHT to 5%-15% depending on the DTA, subject to beneficial-ownership conditions; full exemption is rare for commercial royalties and interest.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Contemporaneous Local File is required when the aggregate annual value of controlled transactions exceeds EGP 8 million, or as amended by ETA ministerial instructions; Master File and country-by-country reporting are separately triggered for large multinational groups above prescribed consolidated revenue thresholds. A TP disclosure form is required with the annual return for all related-party transactions above the de minimis amount.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Egypt does not apply a Gulf-style Economic Substance Regulations code, but the ETA and tax courts apply an economic-substance and beneficial-ownership concept when denying DTA relief, revoking free-zone exemptions, and recharacterizing sham structures. A pure shell Egyptian LLC run from abroad without local management, operational staff, contract control, or risk management is a fatal risk for tax exemptions and treaty rates; the entity must show genuine sorting, storage, dispatch, billing, and decision-making functions in Egypt.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion / False Income Tax Declaration
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate under-reporting of e-commerce parcel revenue, sorting and line-haul fees, customs-handling surcharges, or use of offshore bank accounts and non-institutional payment rails to divert taxable revenue from the Egyptian LLC.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Collection of evaded tax, delay surcharge of 2% per month, and fine up to twice the evaded tax, plus other monetary penalties under Law No. 91/2005 as amended; criminal prosecution and imprisonment may be imposed where fraud is established.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Where a director knowingly signs or directs a false return, conceals revenue, or misuses corporate accounts, the ETA can pierce the corporate veil, impose joint civil liability, issue a travel ban, freeze bank accounts, and pursue criminal imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to prepare or file the Local File or Master File; charging non-arm's-length management, royalty, software, certification, or financing fees to the Egyptian LLC without additional functions; shifting profit by under-invoicing the international line-haul service.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: ETA restates the transaction at market value, assesses additional taxable income at 22.5%, applies monthly delay surcharges, and imposes fixed penalties for non-submission of transfer pricing documentation; unsupported transfer pricing studies are rejected and adjusted.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who execute intercompany arrangements without business substance or knowingly sign misleading transfer pricing schedules may be held jointly and severally liable in sham or abusive-circumvention cases; precautionary asset seizures and travel restrictions may apply.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Abuse of Free-Zone Incentive or DTA
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Creating a nominal Egyptian LLC in a free zone or port-adjacent facility solely to obtain a reduced or zero tax rate, without genuine sorting equipment, staffing, warehouse control, local billing systems, or management decisions in Egypt.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: License cancellation by GAFI, retrospective clawback of corporate income tax and customs duties avoided, statutory surcharges, and denial of treaty benefits under the principal-purpose test and MLI anti-abuse rule.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Managers and legal representatives who certified false economic-substance information are personally liable for clawed-back duties and fines; enforcement includes travel bans, asset seizure, and criminal sanctions for false affidavits.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Failure in Payment Systems
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the parcel consolidation hub as an unregulated payment-routeing or cash-collection point: accepting third-party settlement funds, using Airwallex or local clearing rails to layer transactions, executing transfers for shell e-commerce sellers, and failing to perform customer due diligence or report suspicious transactions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Violation of Law No. 80 of 2002 as amended entails criminal fines, confiscation of funds, licence suspension, and imprisonment for knowing involvement in money laundering; the Egyptian Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Combating Unit may impose preventive freezing orders.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and AML compliance officers who fail to detect suspicious parcel-settlement activity may be prosecuted personally, fined, imprisoned, placed on travel-ban lists, and held civilly liable for laundered moneys.
